# NBAPI 1.5.4

## Trusted proxy validation semantics

- Corrected the web switch to control trusted-proxy source validation rather than disabling forwarded client IP headers.
- When enabled, NBAPI accepts client IP headers only from proxy addresses allowed by `TRUSTED_PROXIES`.
- When disabled, NBAPI trusts `CF-Connecting-IP`, `True-Client-IP`, `X-Forwarded-For`, and `X-Real-IP` directly, regardless of the TCP peer address.
- Added an explicit spoofing warning because validation-disabled mode is safe only when direct access to NBAPI is blocked or every caller is controlled.
- Added regression coverage for trusted and untrusted peers, Cloudflare header precedence, forwarded chains, invalid headers, and direct-address fallback.

## Compatibility

- The existing `TrustedProxiesEnabled` option and its saved value are preserved. No database migration or restart-only configuration change is required.

## Claude Opus 5 usage and cache billing

- Added default cache-read and cache-creation ratios for `claude-opus-5`, including provider-qualified and thinking-variant model names.
- Responses requests forced through Chat Completions now request upstream streaming usage when the channel supports `stream_options`, preserving cache-read token details for settlement and logs.
- Historical Chat Completions cache-read records contain enough usage data for an administrator to calculate an auditable quota correction. Historical Responses records that used local token estimation do not contain recoverable cache token counts and must be reconciled from upstream billing data rather than guessed.
